# external-ips

External IPs are public addresses a tenant holds and binds to a load balancer.

## GET /v1/external-ip-usage

Operation `external_ip_usage_view`.

`GET /v1/external-ip-usage?tenant=<uuid>`: how many external IPs the tenant holds and the limit its next allocation meets.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [ExternalIpUsage](schemas.md#externalipusage)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/external-ips

Operation `external_ip_create`.

`POST /v1/external-ips?project=<uuid>`: reserve an external IP. Refused with `403` `quota_exceeded` when the tenant is at its external IP limit.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [NewExternalIp](schemas.md#newexternalip)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [ExternalIp](schemas.md#externalip)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/external-ips/{external_ip_id}

Operation `external_ip_delete`.

`DELETE /v1/external-ips/{external_ip_id}`: release the address. Refused with `409` while it is bound. Answers `202` with the address in `releasing`; it still counts against the limit until its quarantine ends and reads answer `404`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `external_ip_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `202`: successfully enqueued operation, `application/json`: [ExternalIp](schemas.md#externalip)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
